fusions.name: Pond Squirt
fusions.desc: Squirts pond water at the first enemy in its path up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bellyflop
fusions.desc: You jump and land flat, and the splash deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 8 seconds. It ignores resistance.

fusions.name: Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to return to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Paddle and Pad

riders.text: you cross it faster than ground

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you cross it 15% faster than ground.
